Stargazing evenings - my notes for the first-timer sheet

- Meet in the car park behind Aldmoor library, 7:30pm. Gate is locked at 10pm sharp, no re-entry after that.
- Park nose out and switch your headlights off as you pull in, people's eyes are adjusting.
- Red torches only. A bit of red film over a phone torch is fine. No white light once the sun is down.
- Bring warm layers (it is always colder than you think), a folding chair, a hot drink. Binoculars if you have them, 7x50 are best.
- The club has 3 loan telescopes. Marta keeps the sign-out sheet. Beginners get a short go on each before they can borrow.
- Cloud: Dev decides by 5pm on the day and texts the group. If cancelled we try again the following Friday.
- Free to come. 2 pounds for tea from the urn, cash.
- Children welcome, under 12 with an adult at all times.
- No drones. No laser pointers, except the green one the evening leader uses to point out stars.
- The evening leader is Dev, mobile 07700 900123, if you get lost or are running late.
